en:
//　畏怖のあまり、俺は失禁しかけた。
  ―and I nearly soil myself in terror.

//　光。
  Hikaru.

//　俺はこの上ない愚問を発した。
  I find myself asking the most foolish of questions.
//　俺はＧＨＱの兵士ら――だったもの――を指差した。 I thrust my finger at the GHQ soldiers―at the beasts who㉔were㉓GHQ soldiers.

//　……布武？
  The Law... of Might?

//　指を弾く。
  She makes the motion.
Ichijo is nowhere to be seen. I don't even know if she's still alive―no, she has to be. I allowed her to come on this dangerous mission because I knew that she could be expected to survive.

My comrades are nowhere to be seen. I don't even know if they're still alive―no, they have to be. I allowed them to come on this dangerous mission because I knew that they could be expected to survive.

//　止める間もない。
  There's no time to react.

//　村正の声を理解した刹那、返答の間も俺は惜しんだ。
  The moment Muramasa's words reach my ears, I blast off into the sky.

//　…………
  No response.
